sites.why: Rule 1: embeddings have no Router endpoint (OpenAIEmbeddingClient; EMBEDDING_TEXT_MODEL env, default text-embedding-3-small; base URL EMBEDDING_OPENAI_BASE_URL ?? OPENAI_BASE_URL).

Rule 8: OpenAIInferenceClient.inferFromText chat.completions; baseURL from OPENAI_BASE_URL (unset -> api.openai.com), key OPENAI_API_KEY env, model INFERENCE_TEXT_MODEL env with default gpt-6-luna (catalog id). Uses response_format json_schema/json_object, service_tier, reasoning_effort, max_completion_tokens.

Rule 8: OpenAIInferenceClient.inferFromImage chat.completions with image_url data URI; OPENAI_BASE_URL env defaulting to OpenAI, OPENAI_API_KEY env, model INFERENCE_IMAGE_MODEL env default gpt-4o-mini (catalog id).
Rule 1: embeddings have no Router endpoint (OpenAIInferenceClient.generateEmbeddingFromText, used by EmbeddingClientFactory fallback).
Rule 2: ollama-js generate() against OLLAMA_BASE_URL (self-hosted Ollama); another vendor endpoint. Model is INFERENCE_TEXT_MODEL/INFERENCE_IMAGE_MODEL (user sets an Ollama model).
Rule 1 (embeddings, no Router endpoint); also rule 2 (Ollama host). ollama-js embed().
